integrity: Integral H2 is certified by a primitive cycle basis with an explicit left inverse and a boundary-coordinate determinant of absolute value two. Integral H1 is independently reduced to Z plus Z/4. Mod-two H2, coefficient Bockstein values, all supports through eight vertices, and the topology of all seven integral minimizers are replayed exactly from the full facet table.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the published seventeen-vertex B4 triangulation and to vertex support. The two Bockstein-nonzero mod-two classes have no preferred ordering, so their minimum-carrier counts form the unordered pair {15,20}. Larger supports and other triangulations are not classified.
title: A one-vertex Bockstein gap in the seventeen-vertex flat manifold \(\mathcal B_4\)
